_note: Flooded-area values were measured by counting pixel colors in the 'MVP Prediction' and 'Ground Truth' panels of the 5 demo images published in the flood-detection-cv README. Color mapping assumed: dark blue = land, light green = flood (class 1), dark red = permanent water (class 2). Percent of the whole panel, so no-data pixels cannot be excluded. Approximate. Sample names are neutral numbers in README order (sample_1 = first row ... sample_5 = last row).

sample_1.comment: model missed almost all of the labeled flood area in this tile

sample_2.comment: large connected flood bodies, model agrees well with ground truth

sample_3.comment: thin river and small flood patches
